items.comment: A plain, hymn-like line built on the C chord; the F in bar 5 is a simple passing note into G.

objections.problem: The leap to D5 on beat 3 sits a fourth over the left hand's A, rubbing before the G chord arrives.

items.comment: A tidy two-bar idea stated twice, minuet style; only the leaped-to D over A minor is slightly sour.
Narrow, stepwise and songlike; every non-chord note passes by step, and the F in bar 10 resolves neatly to E.
A simple modal tune over open fifths; nothing to fix.

objections.problem: D-E-D-E-D-C wobbles back and forth; the eighth-note neighbour figure makes bar 7 fidgety rather than singing.
The C-D-C turn at the cadence softens the arrival on C; a plain held C would close the phrase better.

items.comment: The tune's outline is clear, but bars 5 and 7 carry a lot of eighth-note wiggles for a beginner at this tempo.

objections.problem: The repeated G entering off the beat after an eighth rest is a tricky syncopation for a beginner to count.
The melody plays three bars unaccompanied and the left hand answers alone in bar 4; hands never play together here.

items.comment: A natural, singable phrase; the only real hurdle is the off-beat G in bar 2.
